avis.titre: LOVE IT. New Daily Routine Standby.
avis.texte: I couldn't fathom why this product had low reviews so I read some of them and I can't figure out why the 1-star reviewers are spraying this into their eyes. I do not find this product to be the least bit oily. I've never had a problem with it running into my eyes throughout the day (perhaps overapplied?) and I spray it over my closed eyes or with a hand in front of them. I like the pleasant banana? scent and the fine mist that comes out even though it is not aerosol! I have ADHD so a product like this is often my go-to over unscrewing a lid and spreading something across my skin until it absorbs. I like the compact size and feel of packaging in my hand as well. I hope this product is not discontinued due to misuse. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

I use this primarily on my neck and chest. I like the ease of having it right there while I put on the rest of my makeup. Yes, I do need to rub it in, but, I am not breathing it in as that happens with normal aerosols.

avis.titre: It is a product I would not buy again.
avis.texte: I'm giving this product 2 stars because the presentation and size are perfect. However, I didn't like the product itself—it leaves a greasy feeling on the face and makes my hair oily. Since this is a facial product, it should have a neutral taste, as it's hard to avoid getting a small amount in your mouth. Unfortunately, the taste is very bitter.

avis.titre: Awesome sunscreen for reapplication over makeup
avis.texte: I am a super sweaty, combination and sensitive skinned person. Literally every sunscreen I've used over my makeup makes it separate, but this one doesnt! It's a little greasy if you're spraying it near the hairline, but otherwise, it works super well and is fast absorbing! I use this in my esthetician school to make sure I'm protected from the sun, and once accidentally shot it directly into my eye, but it didnt even burn. Love! Love! Love!!!

This sunscreen is convenient and easy to apply, even in a crowd of people. It has the convenience of a spray without the aerosol mist surrounding you since it is a pump. I've used it on my whole body and not just my face. It protects well. The one drawback is that it is a bit sticky to the touch if you spray too much or reapply. It's best when you rub in each application well.

I received the travel size as a fgwp a while back and threw it in my luggage at the last minute before leaving to go to my sister's lake house for a week, I didnt have any expectations one way or the other but boy was I wrong! We all LOVED it and everyone raved about how well it worked and didnt break anyone out and didn't cause any skin irritations! Will definitely purchase the full size!!

avis.titre: Great For More Than Just The Face
avis.texte: I got the for the first time in a little Sun Bum travel kit and fell in love with it. It's nice for a little refresher when you're out and about, but then it also works for a reapplication of sunscreen for the rest of your body when you're out and about. When I take my kids to the pool, we lotion up before we go. But every hour, during the breaks, I make sure and reapply to everyone's faces and then go ahead and use it everywhere use (shoulders, back front, arms....). Same thing at Disney, as we're waiting in line for rides, we'll reapply. Since it's not aerosol, I feel like I have more control of it. I also can take this to sporting events because we're not allowed to have aerosol sprays at Kauffman Stadium when we go watch the Royals play. We're are pale people and this has helped keep us sunburned, lol

Would never recommend this for someone to use on face. The irritation this sunscreen causes for my eyes could nt even be flused out. I wore this once to the beach and it scarred me from trying other face spray sunscreen. Wanted to love it and its sleak design. Using its for thr back of my hands and tops of my feet

This product sincerely feels like you sprayed hairspray into your eyes, except that might be better because at least hairspray wouldn't repeatedly run into you eyes throughout the day. Even when blocking your eyes while spraying, this product is so oily that it ultimately ends up stinging them anyway.
While this sunscreen can look a little on the greasy side if you overdo it, adding the right amount can turn a bare face kind of day into a clean girl day instantly

avis.titre: Do not buy if you want to be able to see
avis.texte: Why make a face spray that when people spray it on their face it burns their eyes so bad they can't open them for 30+ minutes?!

I bought this wanting a misting sun screen with a higher SPF that I could spray over my makeup during the day. DO NOT USE THIS WITH MAKEUP! It made my mascara and eyeliner run like CRAZY! On top of that, the scent was extremely strong and every time I would use it, it would burn my lips. This is the case with any Sun Bum product (for me anyways); sensitive skin around my eyes, nose and lips would burn HORRIBLY. If you're sensitive to achohol and fragrance STEER CLEAR of this product.

My best friend sprayed me (whole body! Not just my face!) with this at an outdoor festival and I was in love. It smells like bubblegum to me ans mists smoothly. I use it as a travel sized spray sunscreen for everywhere. I have very sensitive skin (everywhere) and feel like this didnt break me out.
I was excited to find a "face mist" that i could spray directly onto my face. Alas, you shouldnt do that with this product. It also irritated my eyes after I got wet in the pool.
This reeks of rubbing alcohol and is one of the main ingredients. Returned.

avis.titre: Do not use unless you want burnt eyes
avis.texte: Will burn the crap out of your eyes! Soooo swollen and burning all day

Been using this for a couple months on pool days and on a vacation to Cabo. I love this because it is a mist that can go on over your makeup and places like hairline where other sunscreen forms arent ideal. My fav sunscreen mist!

I love how this spray is such a fine mist it can go on vare skin without feeling greasy or sticky and it goes on beautifully over makeup to make sure tour skin is protected no matter where youre going!

I like the mist of this product. It doesn't leave you white like other sunblock. I personally use it on my body vs my face as I already use my daily SPF face lotion. (My toddler and husband use on their face). The smell isn't overwhelming either.

I usually love all of Sun Bums products but this was a no for me! first the packaging is cute, but it is flimsy and the spray nozzle leaks and feels like it's barely hanging on. The sunscreen itself left me greasy and kept running into my eyes and making them burn. The smell was nice, though! I've been using this to spray my scalp and my kids scalps where their part is so that doesn't burn, but I don't want to put this on my face anymore.

The directions say not to spray directly onto face. Why is the name of the product Face Mist? The point of having an spf face mist is so that you dont have to rub it in and can spritz it over make-up. I love so many Sun Bum products, but this is pointless.

I really like this face mist! Its easy to apply, and i personally love Sun Bum's signature summer scent. My only issue with this sunscreen is that it makes my face look really greasy, no matter how many times i pat it in, so i cant really use it as an every day sunscreen over my makeup, because i prefer a matte look. But this is a great one for those non-makeup days by the pool!

avis.titre: Great addition to my daily routine!
avis.texte: I'm seriously behind on the whole misting sunscreen thing and recently tried Sun Bum's. I love it! I soraybit directly on my face, neck, and top of my shoulders if need be and it keeps my skin hydrated and glowing. It also didnt break me out which is a huge plus. It is a little in the "greasy" side at fitst but settles in nicely. I have used it under makeup and had no problem.
I love it because is easy to use, my children love it to, just close your eyes and mouth

Don't buy this! I ended up purchasing this and using it a couple of times to see if my experience would be different and it wa/ always the same. This did NOT protect me from the sun, it's irritating on the skin with a burning sensation and somehow still runs into the eyes even when you avoid that area. It leaves your face looking GREASY.
I purchased this to use at a music festival where aerosol cans were prohibited. Although it is for faces, I used it on my shoulders, chest, and upper back too. It worked great!
This product is good in theory which drew me to it. The fragrance irritated my skin and was so strong it gave me a headache. Also super greasy.

does not break me out, does leave my skin "glowy" imo not "greasy" i get soooo many compliments when i spray it over top my light summer makeup. i do cover my eyes when i spray and then apply with a spongd around my eyes because any sunscreen is going to burn if you get it in your eyes.

avis.titre: This does not belong on your face
avis.texte: I had to return mine. It was so greasy and awful. The fumes burned my eyes and after just one use my pores were clogged . Please steer clear on face

I have combination skin and I used this SPF to reapply in Disney Florida although it is a little bit greasy it definitely gets better after a bit but what I do is use a oil control powder or blotting papers. I still think it is worth it!!recommended especially for dry skin Ps didnt break me out ( acne prone skin and sensitive to some fragrances)
My grandkids hate sunscreen on their faces and fuss about it all the time, because I insist on sunscreen. They never fuss about using this sunscreen.
I loce this procuct and it's very light-weight on fhe skin, but it BURNS my eyes horribly!!!

I got this because i felt it would be a great way to reapply sunscreen throughout the day. I actually don't mind the smell but make sure to not open your eyes for at least 20 sec after spraying or it will burn. The only thing I dislike is that it makes you look greasy/oily. I have to use powder after

After finding out my favorite Korean SPF mist was discontinued, I bought this for retouching on days when I have makeup on. First, it isn't a mist, it's more like a direct spray. Second, it's EXTREMELY sticky and greasy. I have very dry skin so normally this isn't an issue and sunscreens dry down but this just stayed sticky and greasy, which was uncomfortable, messed up my makeup, and made me look like a greaseball. Third, oh my gosh, does it hurt your eyes. It stings so incredibly bad and even after the stinging went away my eyes were watering so much it was like I was crying. It does have a nice scent so I'll give it that, but you're better off getting an SPF mist from a Japanese or Korean brand that knows what they're doing.

I read the reviews and wanted to try this mist anyways because i love sum bum but there is no reason to have witch hazel in any skincare product. I can already tell why its so drying and irritating to the eyes. An immediate return

avis.titre: Just meh. Same as body spray but more sticky/greasy!
avis.texte: There is nothing different about this spray versus the body sprays. This is just marketing to make it seem special for the face. I would argue that this spray mechanism allows for more fluid to come out at once, which reaults in a sticky feeling. Would not recommend this!
Nice finish but 1 star because never in my life have i had a sunscreen burn my eyes so much. I honestly thought i might go blind.

I'm not one to write reviews. The only reason I'm writing this is to advise all sensitive skin people to skip this face mist. I sprayed this on my face while on the beach. My eyes stung so bad, they also got extremely sensitive to the light. I basically washed my eyes and face with clean water, wiped them with a clean cloth, and kept them closed. All of this DID NOT HELP. The sting sensation lasted 1-2 hrs. I'd recommend to spray mist on hand first, then carefully apply to face while avoiding the eyes and sorrounding areas. I know! Not worth the mist.

avis.titre: Smells great but doesn't really work
avis.texte: I wanted to love this as an easy refresher when im out but unfortunately, this doesn't actjally Prevent sunburn. I got sunburn on parts of my face and was fine on other parts, even though i pretty much soaked my whole face with the spray! So for that reason i would not recommend.

avis.titre: Best face sunscreen I've found... and I've tried a lot
avis.texte: Smells great, doesn't make my skin look greasy, and is super refreshing if you put it in the cooler.
I love it, used at the beach, pro tip leave it in your icechest! It was so refreshing when it was time to reapply, i wish i had found this sooner. I have nothing bad to say about it.

I hate the painstaking process of putting on sunscreen lotion, but hate that spray sunscreen adheres to your skin like a film of super glue and doesn't wash off easily. This sunscreen is the perfect fix. Nice and thin but I've never had issues with burning in odd spots due to a lack of coverage. It feels so light and breathable and washes off far more easily than spray sunscreens. My only wish is that it came with a continuous spray nozzle. Highly recommend. Slightly banana scent which actually is nice when I put this sunscreen on to go on run, it keeps me smelling a little nicer.

I'm trying this out and while I don't mind the SPF lvl and whatnot, the smell is so intense and strong it puts me off from using it because its so overwhelmed fragranced. I've also noticed I tend to get tiny breakouts when I use it. It irritates the eyes so much as well, and it's a constant all day irritation unless you flush your eye for like 10 min. I don't have an issue with the protection but there are too many cons for me

My sister introduced me to it and it was love at first spray. It didn't feel greasy, it lasted a long time, my face felt amazing and the smell was pleasant. I ended up recommending it to my other sister who also loves it. I love the Sun Bum line.
I really enjoy using this sunscreen facial spray—it's a quick way to apply sunscreen before leaving the house, and smells yummy!

i brought this on vacation to Mexico and it worked beautifully! The smell is heavenly. Every day someone was telling me I smelled so good. I was sharing it and recommending it to everyone. I sprayed it directly on my face, neck and chest. Did not irritate my eyes or clog pores after a week of use. Not greasey or heavy. Will repurchase for sure.
I love Sun Bum products and this one is lovely. It is light on the face and also smells nice.

It has a fine mist spray. Smells like delicious banana and coconut. All of these face mists say don't spray onto face but it sprays on fine and in a light, no-cast, even way. Doesn't sting or irritate. Doesn't need to be rubbed in; great on makeup
it works and smells great but burns my eyes if i sweat. might not happen to wveryone but beware.

avis.titre: Don't use if you have acne prone skin
avis.texte: I haven't had a break out this bad in over a year and this was the only change in my routine.

Love the smell, love the simplicity of the spray, works great, my daughter keeps it in her backpack for school and sprays on before PE Love this product for travel, and in my purse for easy application

This mist is easy to use… just mist on or mist into hand and pat on…protected well for full day on my bike. I didn't care for scent… needed a little less chemical smell and a little more fresh scent or maybe coconut since it was on my face all day.

I'm on certain medication that makes me sensitive to sun exposure and I have extremely sensitive skin so I thought it would be worth the money to buy a high quality facial sunscreen. Within a week of use I stared to puff up and have tender skin especially around the eyes and cheeks. I disappointed having spent that much money on a product I won't be able to use.
Great product, I love the smell and how fine the mist is! Super easy to apply and I use daily!

avis.titre: Like the sunscreen, hate the smell
avis.texte: It smells so strongly of bananas I can't use this on a regular occasion unless I'm quite literally at the sea side. The banana smell is overwhelming and will linger for hours.

Pleasantly surprised, I've tried more expensive brands that were aerosol and prefer this in a plastic bottle. Provides broad spectrum coverage for 40 minutes. Ability to reapply at the pool or beach and remain protected!!

I love this method of sun protection. My favorite being the Coola spf 50 face mist with a light scent. This SunBum face mist smells like banana laffy taffy to me, otherwise I enjoy the product but I do go through it quickly.

avis.titre: This will make you a shiny mess
avis.texte: I love sunbum, chapsticks, lotion, face sunscreen, body spray all of it. But this...is awful it will grease up your whole face and make you look shiny...its impossible to blot out. Please note, i do not have oily skin. Smells great though!

I'm glad I found this. My 10-year old son does not like lotion sunscreens, and the spray-on sunscreens for the body clog his pores. This sunscreen sprays on light and does not clog pores. It smells great too!

I have a love hate relationship with this product. It smells amazing, like a banana laffy taffy. It's a good size bottle to fit in purse, it's a super fine mist, its good over makeup, but a little greasy looking if you spray enough product for the SPF to be effective. The thing I HATE about it is sometimes it runs into my eyes and it BURNS. I was basically blind in one eye while driving one time so be verrrry careful

I have a love hate relationship with this product. It smells amazing, like a banana laffy taffy. It's a good size bottle to fit in purse, it's a super fine mist, its good over makeup, but a little greasy looking if you spray enough product for the SPF to be effective. The thing I HATE about it is sometimes it runs into my eyes and it BURNS. I was basically blind in one eye while driving one time so be verrrry careful

avis.titre: Not the Greatest and Not the Worst
avis.texte: This is an okay spf face mist. It did a good job of protecting my skin from the sun, and my skin has not had a bad reaction to it. My issues with it are the smell is very strong and i have to walk away each time i spray so i can breathe. I've noticed it burns my eyes a decent amount as well but that goes away quickly. Leaves skin with an oily look which i don't really mind, it's summer time so I've learned to embrace the oily/dewy look! Also like that it's easy to re-apply on the go. I would recommend only because i haven't tried any other spf face mist and this one is decent, but if your up for it i would recommend looking for another. Probably wouldn't buy again.

avis.titre: worst product I've ever put on my face
avis.texte: I've never had my face react so negatively to a product before! It created itchy rashes & dried my face so bad, now it's peeling. Had to return asap. Would not recommend! But everyone's skin is different & reacts differently. This product was just not for me apparently

The mist is fine and it smells great. Idk what other people are talking about but I did not think that it was greasy and it dried quick in my opinion. I don't use spf daily just when I'm going to be outside all day which isn't very frequent and I think this is great

I never leave product reviews- but I needed to share how much I dislike this product. It is so bad. It smells amazing, but it goes on super greasy and shiny. Also it runs into your eyes and the stinging lasts for HOURS - I used eye drops and also rinsed my eyes and nothing helps. It also somehow dripped into my mouth and tastes god awful. It smells good so it has that going for it….

avis.titre: Worked well on thick blonde hair
avis.texte: I did a couple sprays down my hairline and it left some product but much less greasy than I expected having read the reviews. If you have very fine or thin hair it will probably make it look a few days old (grease wise) but if you have thick or course hair and stick to your part it should be okay. I'm planning to use this for running, hiking, kayaking, etc so I'm also not too worried about my hair looking greasy. It has a pretty classic Sun Bum smell. I would recommend testing it out first if you are wearing it out on a day you want your hair to look it's best!
Love this spf spray! It works well, is easy to apply, smells fantastic and doesn't leave my skin greasy.

avis.titre: Works well but irritating to my eyes
avis.texte: As the headline suggests, it works well. Great sprayer. Great scent. My face didn't get sunburned. This is never my FIRST step but what I used for touching up. No complaints with it doing what it's supposed to do. Down side is it irritates my eyes. Stings slightly and causes watery eyes upon application. And my eyes continue to sting and burn faintly for hours after use, more so after multiple uses. So the first application is a very mild effect. The second more intense. By the third I'm feeling it for ages after and it's quite uncomfortable. Bottom line, I won't be repurchasing and am only using because I have no other option (I'm on vacation right now).
I use this sunscreen every day. This product smells good and isn't irritating.
Easy to apply, not greasy and smells great. I use it on myself and my two kids (7 & 12).
I have dry skin and was looking for a sunscreen to add to my routine and this one wasn't it. I broke out in an itchy rash and my face now has dry patches.

avis.titre: I got burnt when i wore this
avis.texte: I have used this twice now and my face got burnt each time. I was re-applying often so I don't think that was the problem. This also started making my eyes burn and water. Overall disappointed with this as I know its a good brand. Sunscreen should protect you from the sun not let you down and have your face burn still.

avis.titre: an okay option for the price!
avis.texte: this sunscreen is okay, it definitely has protected me from sunburn. i really just keep it in my purse in case im out and need to reapply in a pinch. some warnings tho, 1.) it is pretty greasy….. like i look very oily and slick… def keep in mind in case you're wearing make up 2.) tie alllll your hair back, bc it will get super greasy as well. learned the hard way. 3.) take a deep breath before you spray, breathing in the sunscreen before it sets is spicy and unpleasant 🫠 i think it's okay for the price but would much rather stick to something like the sun bum (or any brand) face stick, or just reapplying the old fashioned way, as bad as it feels. and for make up wearers, im very sorry there just never seems to be any good options.

I bought this because it is promoted as a face list that can go on top of your makeup throughout the day. Not true. Before using, I read the instructions and the first thing it says is NOT to spray directly on the FACE but in hands first then wipe on!! Returned. What a sham!!

I keep this right by the back door, grab and mist my face before going out to do yard work (with a hat) or lounge on the deck(without hat). My skin is sensitive, another term for old. I found this to go on light and not sticky or uncomfortable. It didn't sting my eyes. The coverage and protection is what I was looking for and it has a pleasant smell.

I was looking for a spf face spray w good coverage & non greasy. Pretty disappointed after trying this product. Spray is not easy to come out! I did it several times just to make sure there's enough protection. It felt sticky in the face.

Works pretty good. It makes my face a little oily so I have to go over it with a setting powder. The smell is the only thing I really don't like about it. It has a very powerful alcohol smell when you first spray it but goes away in a few seconds. Just make sure you keep your mouth and eyes closed lol.
I really love this product I use it after I use and apply my make up for an extra protection of sunscreen it has a setting spray kind of mist.

avis.titre: Does not play well with eye makeup.
avis.texte: I bought this specifically to have SPF to reapply over makeup and it made my eye makeup bleed all over the place. I even use waterproof mascara and the UD eyeshadow primer. My face makeup was fine, but mascara is bare minimum for me so I can't use this face spray how I intended to. Also, if you decide to buy this, make sure you press your lips together when you spray your face, otherwise you will taste the sunscreen and it is genuinely awful.

I started using this after unsuccessful purchases of Supergoop! And I love it! It's definitely a mist and sprays very nicely. I just close my eyes very tight and haven't had the burning sensation like others have. It does not feel greasy and it's a great price. I find myself using it much more often than I thought I would. Will definitely purchase this again when it's gone.

I mainly bought it for my neck area but I also spray my face. It does its job, keeps me from getting sun burn. It doesn't smell like anything to me which I really love but many have comment on how good it smells. It's not runny and it has causes me no breakouts which I'm happy about because I have sensitive skin. I only wish they made it in a matte finish because my face & neck look super shiny.

This is one of my favorite products to use before hiking, biking, or even just a daily without makeup on. The fine mist sprays my entire face. This is not a FINISHING SPRAY SPF as some have thought of it as. Close your eyes and spray. I use it on my neck and decollete as well. I keep one in my bathroom and one in my hiking pack. It's easy to reapply and I've often loaned it out to fellow hikers who have forgotten their SPF.

This works very well! The scent smells like bananas IMO. I actually got asked what perfume I was wearing when I wasn't wearing any! Only this face mist. I'm going to be a lifelong fan. I have a very fair complexion, and garden alot. Every 45 minutes to an hour, I just most my face again and I haven't got any sunburn at all, which is very unusual for me in any weather above 70°. It's a fine mist, refreshing, works very well, and is lovely in scent. Perfect product.
This is a fine mist and also smells delicious, highly recommend!!! Leaves a glow which I love because I have drier skin so just beware if you have oiler skin!
I was looking for a good spray 45 that wouldn't ruin makeup and this does the job perfectly! I use some setting spray, wait a couple minutes, and then put this right overtop! Amazing!

This smells so good, but it burns my eyes so bad! Tried it on my toddler too and he had the same reaction. We have to keep our eyes closed for a good min or two after spraying to have a chance of it not burning too bad. But again burns if it runs into the eyes when sweating or swimming. And it does leave a little shine/oil behind so it doesn't absorb completely even when I spray it on my arms. So disappointed! Maybe our eyes are just super sensitive.

It's great for everyday use. It's hard to come by a facial mist nowadays. This one will leave you with a dewy finish. One thing to note is that if you're wearing eye makeup like mascara it's best to avoid the eyes bc the oiliness of the sunscreen willl cause getting your eye products in your eyes, which can burn.

This is a light misty spray to use as a touch up on your face. It's a perfect mist and does not go all over the place. It has no white cast and u don't even have to spread it. I love the smell-like bananas. Great to use in your car or at an out door sorts event

First I didn't have a problem with the smell like other people because I'm not sensitive to Smells. I really like it doesn't leave I white cast on my face and it it sprays on evenly and like a fine mist. It's pretty light on the skin. It's easy to reapply throughout the day even over makeup. As well as being travel friendly. I keep one in the bathroom and one in my car.

avis.titre: Great for dark skin & oily skin
avis.texte: I usually spray this after I've already applied my moisturizer, sunscreen and makeup. I apply my finishing powder and spray this right on top of my face like a setting spray. It goes on a little oily but it dries to a sheer semi Dewey finish.

I tried using this once over makeup and once just over moisturizer, but my eyes watered and burned for hours after applying both times. It smells like artificial banans but the scent dissipates after a few minutes. No greasy residue.

I really like this product, because it's super easy to apply and it has the SPF I require. Also, comparted to other products I've tried, this one has a smell that tolerable. All of the other ones, even Pacifica, smelled strongly like bug spray.

avis.titre: Not for those sensitive to smell
avis.texte: This sunscreen is great, especially for keeping with you on-the-go in your purse or work bag. Eventually I found myself unable to continue using it and had to throw it out because it has a STRONG, LINGERING bubblegum scent! It's pleasant at first, but takes HOURS to dissipate, at which point the smell has already persisted so much it becomes sickening and triggers headaches in me.

avis.titre: To thick and sticky to be used every day
avis.texte: Nope! This product was recommended to me by a sales person. And I told her, that I was using this for daily SPF. The stuff is too thick, it is sticky, and it takes forever for it to dry, cannot put make up over it
Has a strong scent and stung when I put it on my face. Also left it greasy.

I just spent 7 days in the intense Mexico sun, used this throughout the day, after applying a cream face sunscreen in the AM and I have no redness to my face whatsoever. No matter how hard I try I always get a little pink on my forehead area and this spray kept that from happening. It also smells so wonderful

One of the greatest spray I've ever had. I would recommend a sun bum spray with a higher spf if you don't need to put it in a carry-on case. I brought it to Miami for winter vacation and used it under makeup. It worked very well. I also used it on arms and legs.
it absorbs so nicely into the skin and does not burn my eyes. best spray sunscreen I've found at a good price!
Used this for a week rafting through the Grand Canyon. Held up in harsh conditions. It was nice not having to touch my face when it was covered with sand and grit.

I use this product on my face when I leave work for lunch and have to take a long walk thru the parking lot too get to my car. I put sunscreen on in the morning before my makeup and have been searching for sunscreen that I can spray on my face post-makeup. It's a light mist that smells beachy and don't spray on real thick like other sunscreens do. It's an everyday product I keep in my purse now.

I found this product about a month ago. I wish I would've bought more than 1. It is my favorite and my kids favorite face sunscreen. It works well and smells great. All of my friends have been using it now too but now I can't find it in stock anywhere!
I initially loved this but after using a few times, I noticed after a few hours my eyes start stinging and I can only assume it's somehow getting in my eyes and my eyes were stinging for hours.
Over all great product for intended use. Smells like Bananas and attracted gnats, and fruit flies.

I love it because it's so easy to apply and smells great! I recommend spraying farther from the face because if you spray it too close then it can get greasy. This is not only easy to apply, it also has a great even spray so don't worry about spraying more. I gave this four stars because it takes about 20 minutes before it absorbs into the skin, but with a fan or air conditioner it drys much faster. Also, it's a great makeup setting spray if your in a pinch. Love, but be careful if you have oily skin. I have acne and I haven't gotten any more while using this product so I would definitely recommend!
The product was great on the face. Stayed on all day and not greasy. Would recommend.

A hint of banana scent instead of the usual sun bum scent but I LOVE IT! Perfect spray. Just what I was looking for, I keep it in my purse for reapplication after work and to spritz on my daughter if we end up outside. Much softer mist than the aerosol sprays and works much better than the regular spray bottles.

Not impressed. I wanted to like this but the only thing I like is the smell and the fine mist. It irritates my eyes badly, leaves my greasy and oily and does not protect my skin. Can't wait to return this.

I got this because my teens like to fight putting on any sunscreen. They have been good about using it because it doesn't burn! Huge plus. However, when you first put it on there is a strong smell similar to cleaning alcohol. As soon as it dries, that goes completely away, so it would not stop me from buying it again.

First, my kids (9 and 7) and I have very sensitive skin, one has sensory issues and the other has asthma, so finding a sunscreen that is convenient and easy to use as well as safe for asthma (no aerosol,) and eczema, AND doesn't feel sticky/slimy or turn everyone into pale ghostly versions of themselves has been…tricky. I don't even care that this is advertised for faces…we use this on ears, shoulders, necks, and faces. I already knew this is one of few brands that isn't and issue for skin sensitivity, so I gambled on buying this spray because it seemed convenient. We LOVE the smell, it doesn't burn or run into anyone's eyes, it dries well AND doesn't make my acne prone skin break out. This product is a WIN for us.

I love the smell of this spray, and I loved the overall product at first too! However, my eyes started to become very irritated after use. I thought that it was due to the pollen and my allergies, but after stopping use of the product, the irritation went away. I have found that the best way to use this product is to spray it into your hands and then apply onto the face from the fingertips. Therefore, I would not say that this product can be used as advertised.

I have very sensitive skin some of sun bums hair products make me so itchy it's ridiculous I decided to give this a try since I surf. I use it like setting spray couple inches away from the face. It does not make my skin greasy and if it does you're spraying too much. The scent smells like bananas and cream with a hint of ocean spray I love it and I will buy it again Hang loose
I really wanted to like this face spray but it burned as soon as I sprayed it on my face.

avis.titre: Lightweight and perfect for on the go use
avis.texte: The worst part about sunscreen is actually reapplying it every 2 hours. This is perfect to carry around in your bag to reapply a layer of protection throughout the day. Smells like artificial bananas but I love that so I can deal.
This face mist feels awesome not greasy and works great. Smells good too like bananas and coconuts! Makes my face very smooth and soft also.

Only bought it to reapply spf throughout the day over makeup. Used it a few times and makes you look super greasy and smells like banana laffy taffy. After using it it literally leaks product so you have to wipe the grease off the bottle. On top of that it separated my makeup.

I love this product! Smells great, easy to apply. I just use it when I'm going to the beach. This would be a bit too much to wear everyday, but great when you want extra sun protection. My only qualm is it tends to burn my eyes if it sweats into my eyes or I go swimming after applying too much around my eyes. I don't spray it around my eyes and only apply that area sparingly.

avis.titre: love it and will buy again
avis.texte: I was Hesitant to buy this based on the reviews that I read. But being a fan of sunburn products and loving the smell of Sun bum I figured I give it a try. I like facial miss using all the time in this one has ASP F45 sunscreen built into it Create we spend a lot of time outdoors at the museum parks the beach hiking cetera and I carry this in my bag and use it throughout the day . It's not As oily as everyone says it is And I personally love the smell.

First off, what's the point of a mist sunscreen if the instructions say spray it on your hand first. Anywho, sprayed it on using my hands and directly onto my face, went outside for a short 30 min walk with the dogs, came back face red and burnt. Also, my eyes were burning through the whole walk because it was leaking into my eyes and sizzling my corneas. Doesn't work, kills your eyes. Hard pass.

I can't actually speak for the product, I only used it one day. I like spray sunscreen so I can spritz my face as needed throughout the day. I work next to windows, I am 30, and I am terrified of wrinkles. The packaging is terrible. I had this sitting on my desk and somehow the twisty lid wasn't secure (it came like that) and when I went to shake it, the smelly alcohol-y product went flying. I usually buy Ulta brand spray sunscreen, but I decided to switch it up. I am so disappointed in the packaging and the smell. I will not be repurchasing. My warning to you, is if you plan on using this product to travel, tape the container shut so you do not have leaked smelly product all over your stuff.
